title: Care Assistant
company: TRIDENT HEALTHCARE SOLUTIONS LIMITED - Agency - Permanent
description:
Care Support Worker - Care Homes

Pay Rate: £14.43 per hour including holiday pay

Location: Kingsdown Road Swindon SN3 4 TD

Job Type: Agency / Temporary / Flexible

Shift Pattern: Days, Nights, Weekends & Bank Holidays

Hours: Full-time, Part-time and Flexible Shifts Available

About the Role

We are currently recruiting Care Support Workers to work in care homes, nursing homes and residential care settings across Heatherwood, Somerset, Swindon and Kent.

We are looking for caring, reliable and compassionate individuals who are passionate about providing high-quality, person-centred care and supporting residents with their daily needs, wellbeing and independence.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide person-centred care in accordance with individual care plans.
- Assist residents with personal care, including washing, dressing, grooming and toileting.
- Support residents with mobility, transfers and repositioning, in line with training and care plans.
- Assist with meals, eating and drinking where required.
- Provide companionship and emotional support.
- Encourage residents to maintain their independence and participate in activities.
- Observe and report changes in residents' health and wellbeing.
- Maintain accurate daily records and care documentation.
- Follow safeguarding, infection control, health and safety and confidentiality procedures.
- Work effectively with nurses, senior carers and care home management.

Requirements
- Previous experience in a care home, nursing home, residential care or supported living environment is desirable.
- Caring, compassionate and respectful approach.
- Good communication and teamwork skills.
- Reliable, punctual and flexible.
- Willingness to work days, nights, weekends and bank holidays.
- Understanding of person-centred care, dignity and safeguarding.
- Right to work in the UK.
- Relevant care qualifications or training are desirable.
- Enhanced DBS may be required depending on the placement.

What We Offer
- £14.43 per hour including holiday pay
- Flexible agency shifts.
- Day and night shifts.
- Weekend and bank holiday opportunities.
- Weekly pay, subject to agency payroll arrangements.
- Opportunities across Heatherwood, Somerset, Swindon and Kent.
- Training and ongoing support.
- Experience across different care settings.
- Potential longer-term opportunities.

Apply Now

If you are a caring and reliable Care Support Worker looking for flexible agency work in care homes, apply today and join our team.

£14.43 per hour including holiday pay - flexible agency shifts available.

title: Care Assistant - Bank - Care Home
description:
This is a Bank role 0hr contract

ABOUT THE ROLE
This is a casual, part-time role offering flexible working. As a Bank Care Assistant at a Barchester care home, you'll help residents enjoy each day by making sure they get the quality care and support they deserve. You'll assist with daily living, providing support and companionship and sharing great moments and memories too. It's a chance to bring your dedication and compassion to a fulfilling environment. Every day will be different, so you can expect to undertake work that's as varied as it is rewarding. As a Bank Care Assistant, you could be doing anything from supporting residents with their food and drink and following care plans to ensuring that each of our residents has one-to-one time. It's an opportunity to put your skills to meaningful use and develop your career.

ABOUT YOU
To join us as a Bank Care Assistant you'll need to have some experience of caring for older people, a can-do approach and excellent communication skills. Your empathy and warm-hearted approach will shine through, but above all, you'll have the compassion needed to deliver the highest standard of care and support for all our residents. In return we'll provide all the training you need to thrive.

REWARDS PACKAGE
As well as competitive pay, you can look forward to a role that offers true flexibility and plenty of free learning and development opportunities. As one of the UK's leading healthcare providers, we take the growth of everyone who works for us seriously.

As this is a Bank position to provide cover as and when we need it, such as for annual leave or sick leave, the hours and days you work will vary.

If you'd like to use your people skills in an organisation that provides the quality care you'd expect for your loved ones, this is a rewarding place to be.
